correspondences.notes: Reports have no BIDS file counterpart.

brainlife.desc: PDF report or figure, e.g. QA summaries, network plots or quality ratings; for viewing, not for downstream Apps.
brainlife.name: report/pdf

original.desc: Unstructured PDF file for reporting. This datatype is not meant to be used by downstream Apps.

brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Viewing QA reports and figures from App runs.

**Not for:** Input to downstream Apps.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** output of 4 Apps.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/report.pdf.json

identifying_risks: Report may show subject IDs, dates or anatomy of one participant.
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 4: participant-level derived figures without direct identifiers are Tier 2.
sharing_cautions: Check embedded labels and titles for identifiers before sharing.
tier_conditions: Tier 1 for group-level or non-human figures.
Tier 3 if it shows recognisable facial anatomy or names.

intended_use: Viewing QA reports and figures from App runs.

outputs_of.name: Predict functional connectivity from structural connectivity
